ordering_rationale: OpenIM must enforce the channel mute invariant at the authoritative group RPC layer before platform APIs can safely expose channel creation and management. Persistence/client contracts precede handlers. Review and static verification precede the remote deployment gate.

design_decisions.decision: PostgreSQL channel row is the authority for public/private metadata; OpenIM group membership/messages remain the transport layer.
design_decisions.why: OpenIM groups do not supply a public searchable catalog with channel visibility semantics.

design_decisions.decision: Use ch_ and gp_ prefixes, preserve legacy IDs, and enforce channel mute rules in OpenIM group RPC.
design_decisions.why: The OpenIM service is the authoritative layer for both REST and SDK group mute updates.

design_decisions.decision: Public search returns only public channels; private metadata requires membership.
design_decisions.why: Avoid leaking private channel existence/details through directory queries.
